name: system-dashboard
description: Draw a repository's system structure as a single-file HTML dashboard with linted diagrams.

interface.longDescription: Reads a repository, proposes components with evidence files, and lets you choose the views. It then writes a Mermaid source file, checks it against diagram rules (name + type labels, no orphan boxes, agreed arrow meanings, flowchart symbols, tiers), and builds one HTML page: AS IS ▶ TO BE, a performance table with sources, a left-to-right tiered architecture with straight connectors, flowcharts with real use cases beside them, and the related Jira tickets.
defaultPrompt: Draw this repository's system architecture as a one-page HTML dashboard.
Make an AS IS / TO BE structure dashboard for this change with a performance table.
Turn this processing flow into a flowchart with real use cases for the team docs.
